::: {.link-detail data-href="2026-10-29_183718/"}
::: {.callout-tip .status-accepted title="Accepted"}
Without checkpoint reuse, the B3LYP and DD-DFT spectra match the checkpoint-chained ones within $3\,\mathrm{meV}$, so checkpoint reuse did not change the benzene results. A second geometry/screening cycle makes the DD-DFT weights self-consistent with the geometry and moves the spectrum by at most $2.7\,\mathrm{meV}$. Supersedes the [checkpoint-chained workflow](2026-10-21_164931/), rebuilt without checkpoint reuse.
:::
